class.name: cmexa_base/CmexaMecanumBotSystemHardware
class.description: The ros2_control MecanumBot example using a system hardware interface-type. It uses velocity command and position state interface. The example is the starting point to implement a hardware interface for mecanum-drive mobile robots.
